hk.description:
Have you ever wanted to become the villain of a story? 
Legend of Keepers is a mix between rogue-lite and dungeon management, where you play as a dungeon manager hiring monsters and building traps to defeat the heroes coming for your gold. Well, the Dungeons Company is looking for its new Boss and needs you to protect their treasures! You have to experience every company’s struggles in this fantasy workspace simulation, from sick leaves to strikes, and manage your team to run the most impenetrable dungeon! 
In this "reverse-Darkest Dungeon", climb the corporate ladder and optimize your strategy to become the most fearsome (and, perhaps, respected) boss in dungeon history!

Main Features

- Deal with the trials of corporate life: mix and match your roster of bloodthirsty employees to stay on top of the dungeon business
- Don’t play nice for once: be the bad guy and make those smug heroes pay with your mischievous strategies
- Manage your resource budget: On top of morale, gold, blood, and tears must be spent wisely in this economy. 
- Being bad never looked this good: see your enemies perish in drop-dead gorgeous animations. Watch out for stains!

《Children of Morta》是一款以故事為主軸的動作 RPG，結合了 Roguelite 的角色成長特色。在遊戲中，玩家將操控的不僅僅是一位角色，而是一個非凡的英雄家族。

在隨機生成的地牢、洞穴和土地中砍殺成群的敵人，帶領擁有各自優缺點的柏格森家族對抗即將來臨的腐化。故事發生在遙遠的世界，卻觸及我們每個人都熟悉的情感與主題：愛與希望，渴望與不安，失落……以及為了拯救最重要的人所願意付出的犧牲。
這是一個關於英雄家族團結一致，對抗侵襲黑暗的動人故事。

-- 完全版 --

《Ancient Spirits》和《Paws and Claws》DLC 都包含在主遊戲中並可在遊戲過程中解鎖。

特色
- 歡迎加入家族！與英雄般的柏格森家族一起面對挑戰，傳承家族榮耀，拯救瑞亞之地免受腐化侵襲
- 同心協力：在這款 Roguelite RPG 中，每次冒險都能提升整個家族的技能和裝備，讓他們變得更強

SEIZE FORBIDDEN TREASURES. SUMMON ALIEN GODS. FEED ON YOUR DISCIPLES.

BE WARNED. This game has no tutorial - part of the challenge is figuring out how to play. It's hard, but keep trying, and you'll master it. Good luck!

In this infamous roguelike narrative card game, play as a seeker after unholy mysteries in a 1920s-themed setting of hidden gods and secret histories. Become a scholar of the unseen arts. Craft tools and summon spirits. Indoctrinate innocents. Seize your place as the herald of a new age.

Cultist Simulator was first released on PC and has more than 200,000 players all over the world. Now we’re bringing the cosmic mysteries of Cultist Simulator to mobile.

• Challenging roguelike gameplay - There is never only one history.
Cultist Simulator doesn’t hold your hand. Experiment, expire and transcend death with a story-driven legacy system. Over time you’ll learn enough to wrestle the game to its knees.

• Intense, immersive narrative – Combine cards to tell your own story.
A hefty novel’s worth of choice-based storytelling, from the creator of Fallen London and Sunless Sea. There are many paths through this game of ambition, appetite and abomination, and many ways your tale can end.

• A rich Lovecraftian world – Corrupt your friends and consume your enemies.
Search your dreams for sanity-twisting rituals. Translate grimoires and glean their lore. Penetrate the realm of the Hours and win a place in their service. Cultist Simulator brings the peripheral horror of Lovecraft’s tales to an entirely new setting.

Expand your knowledge with the DLCs: New Legacies, New Ascensions, New Mechanics...
• The Dancer - Join the Bacchanal
• The Priest - Knock, and Ye Shall Be Opened
• The Ghoul - Taste of the graveyard's fruit
• The Exile - Some there are who will not yield

在這個快節奏的動作rogue-lite遊戲《孤骨勇士》中，失去頭顱反而是戰鬥的一部分。

遊戲擁有100位獨特能力的可操控角色，配合眾多道具，可創造出既瘋狂又具挑戰性的戰鬥。
魔王城廢墟
人類對魔王城的攻擊歷史悠久，此次卻與眾不同。
這次不僅冒險家加入戰鬥，還有帝國軍隊和被稱為「卡倫之英雄」的領袖共同發動全面攻擊，決心一舉根絕魔族。

黑暗鏡子模式
完成主線故事後，挑戰自我極限，試試全新的「黑暗鏡子」模式吧！

遊戲特色
- 在這場魔族的絕望之中，你是最後的希望！化身為小小骷髏「孤骨」，踏上旅程去擊敗狂妄的英雄們，解救被卡倫墮落軍隊俘虜的魔王。
- 換上新的孤骨，感受失去頭顱的痛快：借用前任擁有者的力量和華服，搭配獨特的道具來創造連鎖技能，戰勝敵人。

- 觀賞充滿活力、風格卡通的像素藝術2D動畫，幫助各種魔族生物恢復本來面目。
- 從埃及的木乃伊到希臘的牛頭怪，甚至《Dead Cells》的官方跨界合作……你能找到遊戲中所有有趣的彩蛋嗎？

hk.description:
Death is not the end.

Play as a failed alchemic experiment and explore the sprawling, ever-changing castle to find out what happened on this gloomy island…! 
That is, assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers.

Dead Cells is a roguevania action platformer that will require you to master frantic 2D combat with a wide variety of weapons and skills against merciless minions and boss.

Kill. Die. Learn. Repeat.

First available on PC and consoles, the indie hit Dead Cells is now slaying foes on mobile!

Main Features
• Roguevania: The progressive exploration of an interconnected world, with the replayability of a rogue-lite and the adrenaline-pumping threat of permadeath

• Frantic and Dynamic 2D Action: Learn your enemies’ patterns to stay alive, or prepare to be sent back to your cell before you can say “baguette”

• Nonlinear Progression: Unlock new levels with every death, opt for the path that suits your current build, your playstyle or just your mood. 
Surely, the ramparts can’t be as bad as the sewers, right?

• Play at your own pace: Will you explore every nook and cranny of the castle, or rush to the end?

*Latest updates are available: Clean Cut & The End is Near*

RETURN TO CASTLEVANIA DLC
Time for some vampire slaying
• New storyline - overcome the Ruler of Darkness alongside Alucard and Richter Belmont,
• 2 new biomes - Explore Dracula's Castle and its outskirts
• 9 new monsters - Werewolves, haunted armors, and medusas are waiting for you
• 14 new weapons - wield the Vampire Killer or the Holy Water to defeat creatures of the night,
• 3 new bosses - go fangs to fangs against Death and Dracula himself
• 20 new outfits - dress as your favorite Castlevania characters such as Simon and Richter Belmont or Alucard
• Alternative soundtracks - play along 51 Castlevania original tracks and 12 tunes reimagined in the style of Dead Cells

THE BAD SEED DLC
You reap what you sow
• New levels to lose your head in the not-so-peaceful Dilapidated Arboretum and the noxious Morass of the Banished
• New monsters to rip to pieces: get to know the locals, such as the Jerkshroom and the Yeeter
• New weapons to play with: trim sticking-out heads with the Scythe Claw, or make them dance to the sound of the Rhythm n' Bouzouki
• New boss to fight against: Mama Tick is dying to meet you

FATAL FALLS DLC
Ready for a leap of faith?
• 3 new biomes - Get some fresh air at the Fractured Shrines, splash around at the Undying Shores and take a picture at the Mausoleum
• 8 new monsters - The Cold Blooded Guardians and their friends would love to teach you about their culture. ... Wait, aren't those relatives of yours in the Undying Shores...?
• 7 new weapons - Lil' Serenade is perfect for breaking the ice with the locals, although the Snake Fangs would make for a perfect souvenir...
• 1 new boss - The Scarecrow is very proud of his gardening skills and won't hesitate to show off


QUEEN AND THE SEA  DLC
Take it to the sea!
• 2 new biomes - Battle your way through a rotten shipwreck, or scale a burning lighthouse and confront your deadliest foe yet.
• 9 new weapons, including a throwable shark, a trident and a pirate hook hand (eyepatch not included). 
• 2 new bosses - Don't lose your head before you meet the Queen!

This DLC also gives you the usual extras: 
- A not-so-cute pet. 
- Loads of new outfits. 
- New enemies to bash.

WARNING: Devices with less than 2 Gb of RAM may not be able to run this content correctly. We recommend not to take this DLC if your device is under 2gb of RAM.

• MFi external controller support

• No ads, no F2P mechanics!

Adopt a young Lebensborn child in Norway after World War 2. Parenting will be hard as your child grows up in a hostile and hateful environment. 
Can you help Klaus/Karin cope with the heavy inheritance of the German occupation, so they will find their place in a country that is celebrating its freedom?

- Influence the child’s feelings, personality and worldview through your choices.

- Use your time and meagre resources wisely.
- Look for the effects of your choices in your child’s expressions and body language.
- Explore a gripping storyline based upon true events.

Parts of the game's proceeds are donated to help protect Children Born of War (children born of enemy soldiers and local women).

Kill. Die. Learn. Repeat.

You reap what you sow

Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimize routes to maximize each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb toward mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the US and UK, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cozy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimise routes to maximise each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb towards mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the UK and US, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls

pt.description:
Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.
